rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_constrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.3516, n_angles=128, n_det=1024, det_spacing=0.35754, sod=500.0, sdd=1000.0, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.5, train_n=400, val_n=200, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_constrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=16, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.3, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, rationale=iter-4 EXPLORATORY, single knob fd_recon_steps 8->16 from iter-2 base (init_t=0.3, dc_relax=0.5 reverted - iter-3 full DC dc_relax1.0 gave NO gain: rmse 0.01307->0.01372, matching the Mayo sibling finding). SIX-BOX: (1)PRIOR: iters 1-3 all hr=0; best rmse=0.01307 at iter-2 (init_t0.3). init_t mapped (0.7->0.3: ssim 0.775->0.908, rmse flat), dc_relax mapped (0.5->1.0: no gain). Recon rmse pinned ~2.5x the FBP baseline 0.00521. (2)FAILURE MODE: few-step (8) Euler integration of the cross-dataset flow is coarse; discretization error may inject error the DC cannot remove. (3)ONE KNOB: fd_recon_steps 8->16 (finer NFE; init_t/dc_relax/eta held). (4)HYPOTHESIS: doubling Euler steps reduces flow discretization error so the prior denoises more faithfully and rmse drops toward the FBP floor, probing whether hr moves off 0. (5)BUDGET: iter-1 (8 steps,200 slices) ~178s; 16 steps ~2x sampling ~360-400s, well inside the HARD 20-min budget. (6)Loop continues; iter-5 self-dispatched. Reserved last orthogonal lever: fd_recon_eta.
